source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

items.name: Consume Flesh
items.text:
Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

---
Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 5d6 healing Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

items.name: Ghoul Whispers
items.text:
Requirements A Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, or Unconscious creature is within the ghoul's reach

---
Effect The ghoul whispers dark thoughts and vile cravings into the creature's ears. The creature must save against the forbidden cravings curse.

Forbidden Cravings (curse) A creature can still eat and drink while sickened by this curse

Saving Throw DC 26 Will save

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 void damage and the target is Sickened 1 until it consumes raw meat (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2

Stage 4 as stage 2 unless the target has consumed raw meat in the past 24 hours, then it takes 4d6 void damage and is Sickened 2 until it consumes raw meat;

Stage 5 if the creature has eaten raw meat in the past 24 hours, it dies and rises as a ghoul, if not, it returns to stage 4

items.name: Grave Knowledge
items.text:
Frequency once per hour

---
Effect The ghoul calls upon knowledge it retains from one creature it has consumed in the past 7 days. The ghoul attempts a skill check using a skill in which the consumed creature was trained (if it's unclear whether the creature was trained, the GM decides). The ghoul is treated as trained with a +18 skill modifier. This takes the same amount of actions or time as usual for the check.

The ghoul can instead automatically learn something specific known by a creature it consumed in the last 7 days, like the location of a Hidden treasure or the name of a loved one. The ghoul can do this only once for a given creature, no matter how much of its flesh the ghoul consumed.

items.name: Swift Leap
items.text: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
